name: Paste clipboard images onto Stories
description:
Paste an image from the system clipboard onto a Story in the TUI. Rowbly has no attachments today, so this adds an **Attachments** Built-in Plugin.

## User experience

1. The user takes a screenshot or copies an image.
2. In the TUI they open a Story, or the new-Story form.
3. They press their paste key: **Ctrl+V**, **Alt+V** or **Ctrl+Alt+V**, or the terminal's own paste key where the terminal sends an empty bracketed paste.
4. Rowbly reads the image from the system clipboard and attaches it to the Story. A toast confirms it (`Attached image-20261025-1432.png (412 KB)`).

It must work for most people on macOS, Windows and Linux. Where pasting can't work (SSH, headless, unsupported platform), Rowbly shows a clear toast, and `rowbly attachment add <KEY> <file>` still works.

## Decisions

- Read the clipboard with the native module `@mariozechner/clipboard` (source: https://github.com/earendil-works/clipboard), pinned to `0.3.9` and loaded lazily. Rowbly keeps working when it can't load.
- On Wayland without XWayland, fall back to `wl-paste`. No fork or upstream PR for now.
- Pasted images are stored as PNG. The module converts macOS TIFF and Windows DIB images to PNG.
- Images are Plugin files of the Attachments Plugin: `boards/<b>/stories/<KEY>/plugins/attachments/<id>.png`, listed in a bag on the Story.

## Facts checked while researching (2026-10-25)

- **Terminals:** they never send the image; Rowbly has to read the system clipboard itself when a key arrives. Ctrl+V reaches the app as `\x16` in macOS terminals and most Linux terminals. Windows Terminal and the VS Code terminal take Ctrl+V for their own paste, hence Alt+V (Claude Code uses Alt+V on Windows too). Ink 8 has `usePaste` for bracketed pastes.
- **Package API:** `hasImage()` is synchronous; `getImageBase64()` and `getImageBinary()` return PNG (`number[]`, so prefer base64 for large images).
- **Prebuilt binaries:** shipped as optional dependencies for darwin x64/arm64/universal, linux x64/arm64 gnu+musl, riscv64, and win32 x64/arm64. N-API 4, no install script.
- **Linux:** the published binaries are X11-only (the `wayland` cargo feature is off in release CI). On GNOME and KDE Wayland they work through XWayland: tested on a GNOME Wayland session, `hasImage()` was true and a 3.6 KB PNG was read in 55 ms after `wl-copy`.
- **Storage:** Plugin files and the commit journal handle only text today (`io.writeFile` is utf8; journal writes are `{ kind: 'write'; text }`; `FileChange.before`/`after` are strings).
- **Keys:** Plugin keys work only inside their own tab, and Actions take one character. Pasting across the whole Story screen needs a new Plugin API hook.
